identity_chain: AdaniConneX's own About Us page (captured 6 November 2026) lists, among its certifications, 'Environmental Clearance Certificate - EC Certificate of ACXNMI-1 by M/s Support Properties Pvt. Ltd.' and links this PDF; the same section lists the PNQ26 and PNQ27 ECs and compliance reports of AdaniConneX's Pune entities. 'ACXNMI' is AdaniConneX's Navi Mumbai designation (the Maharashtra SEAC-2 agenda of August 2026 lists an 'ACXNMI Site-02', held in sources/research-countries-2026-10-23-fortyfourth-holds.json).
The EC places project ACXNMI-01 at Plot No. A-GEN-4, T.T.C. Industrial Area, MIDC Rabale, Village Savli, Ghansoli (Navi Mumbai), on a plot of 25.19 ha with seven planned data-centre buildings.

Adani Enterprises' Q2 FY27 results presentation (submitted to BSE and NSE on 28 October 2026), slide 'AEL: Energy & Utility - Adani ConneX (ACX)', lists under Navi Mumbai 'Ghansoli - 220 MW| Execution started' and 'Taloja - 240 MW| New Order Received'. Ghansoli is therefore one of two named AdaniConneX Navi Mumbai sites; it matches the village named in the EC. No other AdaniConneX project in Ghansoli was found.

Visual check only, not used to derive the point or the status: an Esri World Imagery export of about 1.05 by 1.0 km around the point (local esri/esri-ghansoli-acxnmi01.jpg, imagery date not stated) places the point on a building site with a grid of foundations and concrete column stubs, site cabins and plant, inside a large walled tract of cleared and graded land east of the Thane-Belapur road corridor.
excluded_geometry: No map-service feature, map link or embedded map parameter was used. AdaniConneX's pages load a Google Maps widget; its parameters were not read.
The imported record 'AdaniConneX Navi Mumbai data centre campus' (19.0308, 73.0199) is a Navi Mumbai city centroid from a geocoder, 9.81 km away, and is not a site locator.
The proponent's registered office in Andheri East (Mumbai) printed in the EC is not used.
precision: Project coordinate printed in the SEIAA Maharashtra environmental clearance for data-centre project ACXNMI-01 on Plot No. A-GEN-4, TTC MIDC Rabale, Ghansoli (25.19 ha). It locates the campus plot as a whole, not a particular data-centre building, a surveyed boundary, an entrance or the part of the plot where works have started.
uncertainty_reason: The EC states no datum, survey method or positional accuracy for its coordinate, and the point stands for a 25.19 ha plot (roughly 500 m across) whose boundary is not published.
